BacnetAddress.description: A BACnet object and property. Multi-state values are 1-based: state 1 is enum[0].
BacnetAddress.title: BacnetAddress

BacnetMstpConnection.description: A BACnet MS/TP device on a trunk (milestone 4c).
BacnetMstpConnection.title: BacnetMstpConnection

BacnetMstpTrunk.description:
A BACnet MS/TP trunk, run by the bms-mstp service on the host (main spec 5.1, 9, 11; milestone 4c).

The service owns the serial port and is the MS/TP master node; the backend reads devices
through its local API. The port and MS/TP settings here must match the service's settings
(`mstp/` in the repository); the commissioning check compares them.
BacnetMstpTrunk.title: BacnetMstpTrunk

BacnetSettings.description: The BMS's own BACnet/IP identity on the device network (main spec 5.1, 5.11).
BacnetSettings.title: BacnetSettings

CustomSymbol.description:
A site's own symbol (main spec 6.4, milestone 9B): drawn in the editor or imported.

`svg` is cleaned (graphics/sanitize.py) and has `state-off` and `state-on` groups.
CustomSymbol.title: CustomSymbol

EquipTemplate.description: An equipment or room template (main spec 5.1.2). Each version is a separate entry.
EquipTemplate.title: EquipTemplate

FillRule.description: Proportional fill: 0 to 100 % of the point's value (or of min..max).
FillRule.title: FillRule

FollowsRule.description: A pipe or duct coloured like a symbol: On shows flow, Off is grey.
FollowsRule.title: FollowsRule

Graphic.description: A live graphic (main spec 6.4): a drawing area in its own units with bound items.
Graphic.title: Graphic

GraphicBackground.description: An imported SVG drawn under everything else (milestone 9B), for example a floor plan.
GraphicBackground.title: GraphicBackground

ModbusBusConnection.description: A device on a bus: its unit (slave) ID and how many registers it reads at once.
ModbusBusConnection.title: ModbusBusConnection

ModbusRtuBus.description: An RS485 line on a serial port (main spec 5.1). One adapter and port per bus, never shared.
ModbusRtuBus.title: ModbusRtuBus

ModbusRtuOverTcpBus.description: A serial-to-Ethernet gateway that passes raw RTU frames over TCP (main spec 5.1).
ModbusRtuOverTcpBus.title: ModbusRtuOverTcpBus

ModbusTcpGatewayBus.description: A serial-to-Ethernet gateway that converts Modbus TCP to RTU, addressing devices by unit ID.
ModbusTcpGatewayBus.title: ModbusTcpGatewayBus

MqttAddress.description:
Where an MQTT point's value comes from (milestone 4d).

Plain: the whole payload is the value, for example `21.5`, `ON` or `true`.
JSON: `json_path` picks a field with dots between names, for example `ENERGY.Power`
(Tasmota), `temperature` (Zigbee2MQTT) or `apower` (Shelly Gen2). A number in the path
picks a list entry, for example `channels.0.value`.
MqttAddress.title: MqttAddress

MqttBroker.description:
An MQTT broker that field devices publish to (main spec 5.1, milestone 4d).

Usually the site's own Mosquitto (the bms-mqtt container, main spec 11). The password is
never in the config file: `password_env` names an environment variable that holds it.
MqttBroker.title: MqttBroker

MqttConnection.description:
An MQTT device: the broker it publishes to, and its optional availability topic.

When the availability topic carries `availability_offline` (for example Tasmota's LWT
"Offline"), every point of the device is Bad (down) until a new value arrives.
MqttConnection.title: MqttConnection

MstpRouter.description:
bms-mstp routes this trunk to BACnet/IP (milestone 8): its BACnet/IP side uses `interface`,
a labelled address on the device-network port such as eth1:mstp1 with `address`, port 47808.
The same settings go in the service's env file (BMS_MSTP_ROUTE_ARGS).
MstpRouter.title: MstpRouter

OccupancyMap.description:
What a writable point is set to when its equipment's schedule is Occupied or Unoccupied
(milestone 7B), for example On and Off, or 22 and 26 °C.
OccupancyMap.title: OccupancyMap

OfflineAlarm.description: An alarm when a device stops answering (main spec 5.5). Only on devices where it is set.
OfflineAlarm.title: OfflineAlarm

PointAlarm.description:
An alarm on a point (main spec 5.5): a high or low limit, a state, or stale data.

high: raised when the value is above `limit`; it returns to normal below limit - deadband.
low: raised below `limit`; returns above limit + deadband.
state: raised while a Bool or Str point equals `state`.
stale: raised while the point's value is Stale.
Only Good values raise or clear limit and state alarms (main spec 5.2.1).
PointAlarm.title: PointAlarm

SymbolShape.description: A shape of a symbol drawn in the editor, on the 64 x 64 grid (milestone 9B).
SymbolShape.title: SymbolShape

TemplateLink.description:
Equipment (or a room) made from an equipment template (main spec 5.1.2, milestone 5A).

`bindings` names the point that fills each role. Overrides are not stored: a point field
that differs from what the template's role gives it is an override, and a template update
leaves it alone (an override always wins).
TemplateLink.title: TemplateLink

TemplateRole.description: A named point an equipment template expects (main spec 5.1.2), with the point fields it gives.
TemplateRole.title: TemplateRole

ValueBand.description: One band of a value-band rule: values below `below` (the last band has none) get `colour`.
ValueBand.title: ValueBand

WriteLimits.description: The range the server accepts for a command to a Number point (main spec 5.6), for every role.
WriteLimits.title: WriteLimits
